title: Prompt and Prejudice
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus was on revealing demographic biases based on gender and ethno-national backgrounds, which were proxied by first names.
findings: The paper does not report any findings related to religion, as it was not a component of the study.
